To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the perceived learning assistance and the perceived community building assistance are the key factors influencing students’ perceived academic performances.

1) Perceived ease of use, perceived usefulness and how an e-learning system is used are positively related to perceived learning assistance and community building assistance; 2) Perceived learning assistance and communitybuilding assistance are positively related to students' perceived academic performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the outcomes of e- learning systems usage.
the outcomes of using e-learning systems in higher education.
the investigation of the possible outcomes of the adoption and use of e-learning systems in the university context.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the study has shown that students’ perceptions about the learning assistance and the community building assistance that e-learning systems offer, are important in explaining students’ academic performance.
the results from this research have shown that there is a significant relationship between the e-learning system usage and academic performance, which is consistent with previous studies.
the study found that the students perceived learning assistance and community building assistance to have a significant impact on perceived academic performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the results show that the e-learning system usage has an effect on the students perceived learning assistance and community building assistance.
e-learning systems are not only about technology but about how the system can help the students to learn and build a community of learners.
we have developed and tested a model of how students perceive e-learning system usage, which can be applied to a range of different e-learning systems.

the outcomes of e- learning systems adoption and use are multidimensional.
the use of e-learning systems in the university context has a positive influence on student academic performance, which is a key indicator of student learning.

e-learning system use has positive impacts on students’ learning and academic performance, and that these impacts are mediated by students’ perceptions of the learning system and the community it facilitates.
